verdict.rationale: OCI documents an official CLI that offers the Console's core functionality plus additional commands. It installs across Oracle Linux, macOS (including Homebrew), Windows, Linux and Unix, comes pre-configured in Cloud Shell, and supports token-based auth without a keypair; a probe also confirms the official CLI docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documentation of agent-friendly specifics such as structured/JSON output or non-interactive scripting behavior.
